button.description: Send a remote button press to the TV.

Name of the button to press. Known values include LEFT, RIGHT, UP, DOWN, HOME, BACK, ENTER, MENU, EXIT, INFO, DASH, ASTERISK, CC, MUTE, VOLUMEUP, VOLUMEDOWN, CHANNELUP, CHANNELDOWN, PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, RED, GREEN, BLUE, YELLOW, POWER, 0-9 and the pointer/IME specials CLICK, MOVE, SCROLL and TEXT.
